steps.description:
A **regular hexagon** has all 6 sides equal and all 6 angles equal. With side length $s = 12$ cm, we need to find:
- **(a)** The perimeter — total distance around the outside
- **(b)** Each interior angle — using the polygon angle formula
- **(c)** The total area — by splitting the hexagon into 6 equilateral triangles from the center

The key insight for part (c): a regular hexagon is made of exactly **6 congruent equilateral triangles**, each with the same side length as the hexagon. This is the elegant shortcut that makes area easy.
steps.title: Understand the Problem

steps.description:
A regular hexagon has **6 equal sides**, so the perimeter is simply:
$$P = 6 \times s = 6 \times 12 = 72 \text{ cm}$$
steps.title: Find the Perimeter

steps.description:
For any **regular polygon** with $n$ sides, the sum of all interior angles is $(n-2) \times 180°$. Dividing by $n$ gives each individual angle.

With $n = 6$:
$$\text{Each interior angle} = \frac{(6-2) \times 180°}{6} = \frac{4 \times 180°}{6} = \frac{720°}{6} = 120°$$
steps.title: Find Each Interior Angle

steps.description:
Drawing lines from the center to each of the 6 vertices splits the hexagon into **6 identical triangles**. Each triangle has:
- Two sides that are radii of the hexagon
- One side that is a side of the hexagon ($12$ cm)

Since the hexagon is regular, by symmetry each of the 6 central angles equals $\frac{360°}{6} = 60°$. Two sides of each triangle are equal (both radii), and the angle between them is $60°$ — this forces all three angles to be $60°$, making every triangle **equilateral** with side length $12$ cm.
steps.title: Identify the 6 Equilateral Triangles

steps.description:
The area of an equilateral triangle with side $a$ is derived by dropping a height $h$ from the apex to the base, splitting it into two 30-60-90 triangles:
$$h = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a$$

So the area is:
$$A_{\triangle} = \frac{1}{2} \times a \times h = \frac{1}{2} \times a \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}a^2$$

Substituting $a = 12$:
$$A_{\triangle} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 12^2 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 144 = 36\sqrt{3} \text{ cm}^2$$
steps.title: Area of One Equilateral Triangle

steps.description:
Since the hexagon is made of **6 congruent equilateral triangles**:
$$A_{\text{hexagon}} = 6 \times A_{\triangle} = 6 \times 36\sqrt{3} = 216\sqrt{3} \text{ cm}^2$$
